decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - Given the unique geographical position of the house within the streetscene, although the proposals do not fully comply with the relevant policies the proposed two storey side extension and single storey front extension to this end of terrace house, would, by reason of their size, scale, and appearance not cause harm to the appearance of the building, the character and appearance of the area, or the living conditions at neighbouring properties, in accordance with policies ENV-B.1.1 and H.6.4 of the Adopted Unitary Development Plan.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
description: Erection of a two storey side and single storey front extension to house.
